approval_source.question_set: Whether T05 reads memory and CPU from the hosts' monitor history (user, 13 November 2026: 'proceed with your recommendations on the remaining items')

reason: P01_T06_R03_T05_WITHIN_HETZNER_LIMITS_2026-11-13 left T05's memory and CPU unmeasured, taking no reading to exist. Each host's monitor (host/monitor.py) already samples host CPU and memory every minute into its sealed daily history.

decisions.question: T05 memory and CPU reading
decisions.selected: Read from each host's monitor history for the T05 window
decisions.rule: After 16 November's history is sealed and uploaded, the founder opens it (dytallix-root-sign history-open via staging_founder.py) and the T05 result reports, per host, peak and median memory percent and CPU percent at each rate step. This is host-wide memory, not the node cgroup alone; the hosts run only Dytallix. It answers the 3 GiB question of P01_E05_TWO_SEATS_2026-10-11 as far as host-wide readings can.

supersedes: the 'T05 memory and CPU reading: not measured in this run' decision of P01_T06_R03_T05_WITHIN_HETZNER_LIMITS_2026-11-13
does_not_authorize: any change to the monitor or its sample rate
contacting either host beyond the approved T05 window
